title: script.md — "₹100 a Day → ₹1 CRORE" (30s Short)
caption: ₹100 a day is the cheapest habit that ever made me money.

beats.name: THE SLAP
beats.visual: Coin drops into empty jar. Rupee symbol blazes on the wall.
beats.motion: Coin drop + clink. Text slams in with scale pop + shake.

beats.name: THE CONTEXT
beats.vo: See, ₹100 a day is only ₹3,000 a month.
beats.visual: 30 coins stack beside the jar. Calendar ticks off day by day.
beats.motion: Coins drop one by one, stacking. Calendar squares pop as they tick.

beats.name: THE INSIGHT
beats.vo: And parked in a bank account, that's nothing. But invested? That ₹3,000 starts working.
beats.visual: Coins fly from the jar into a green rising chart. Line draws upward.
beats.motion: Coin arcs with sparkle trails. Chart line draws left→right with a glow head.

beats.name: 10 YEARS
beats.vo: At 12% a year, 10 years becomes ₹7 lakh.
beats.visual: Jar fills and overflows. Gold badge appears with a stamp.
beats.motion: Jar fills in 2s. Badge stamps with ring ripple. Count-up digits roll.

beats.name: 20 YEARS
beats.vo: 20 years? ₹30 lakh. Still no salary raise. Just the same coin, every day.
beats.visual: Coins become a mountain taller than the character. Chart hits ceiling.
beats.motion: Mountain grows from the pile with a coin-rain effect. Character jumps on beat.

beats.name: THE PAYOFF
beats.vo: 30 years? One crore. The coin did the work. You just didn't spend it.
beats.visual: Mountain towers to the ceiling. Character climbs it, stands on top, raises the same coin.
beats.motion: Deep boom + gold flash. Badge pulses huge. Firework sparkles. Hold S6-I4 longest.

beats.name: THE CALLBACK + CTA
beats.vo: So no, ₹100 won't change your life today. But 30 years of it? One crore. Follow for more money lessons in 30 seconds.
beats.visual: Mountain calms back to a full jar. Character looks at the viewer, thumbs up.
beats.motion: Slow zoom out. Lines fade in one at a time. Follow button pops with a bounce.

texts.text: ₹100 WON'T CHANGE TODAY. IT WILL CHANGE 30 YEARS.
